sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.SKU AS sku, p.ProductName AS name, p.PimProductId AS productId, pp.price AS price, ad.addOnProductId AS addOnProductId, ad.addOnName AS addOnName, ch.child1Sku AS child1Sku, ch.child1Name AS child1Name, ch.child2Sku AS child2Sku, ch.child2Name AS child2Name, ch.child3Sku AS child3Sku, ch.child3Name AS child3Name, cat.categoryName AS categoryName, br.brandName AS brandName FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId = p.PublishStateId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.StoreCode = @store CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 COALESCE(pr.SalesPrice, pr.RetailPrice) AS price FROM dbo.ZnodePrice pr INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList pl ON pl.PriceListId = pr.PriceListId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal plp ON plp.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId WHERE pr.SKU = p.SKU AND plp.PortalId = po.PortalId AND pr.RetailPrice > @minPrice AND (pl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (pr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pr.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pr.ExpirationDate >= @now) ORDER BY plp.Precedence, pl.PriceListId) pp OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 ao.PimProductId AS addOnProductId, ao.ProductName AS addOnName FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct ap INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddonGroup g ON g.PimAddonGroupId = ap.PimAddonGroupId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProductDetail apd ON apd.PimAddOnProductId = ap.PimAddOnProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct ao ON ao.PimProductId = apd.PimChildProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory ai ON ai.SKU = ao.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse apw ON apw.WarehouseId = ai.WarehouseId WHERE ap.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND ao.IsActive = @isActive AND apw.PortalId = po.PortalId AND (@addOnDisplayType IS NULL OR g.DisplayType = @addOnDisplayType) AND EXISTS (SELECT apr.SKU FROM dbo.ZnodePrice apr INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList apl ON apl.PriceListId = apr.PriceListId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal aplp ON aplp.PriceListId = apl.PriceListId WHERE apr.SKU = ao.SKU AND aplp.PortalId = po.PortalId AND apr.RetailPrice > @minPrice AND (apl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR apl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (apl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR apl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (apr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR apr.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (apr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR apr.ExpirationDate >= @now)) GROUP BY ao.PimProductId, ao.ProductName, ap.DisplayOrder, apd.DisplayOrder ORDER BY ap.DisplayOrder, apd.DisplayOrder, ao.PimProductId) ad OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn = @n1 THEN kc.SKU END) AS child1Sku, MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn = @n1 THEN kc.ProductName END) AS child1Name, MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn = @n2 THEN kc.SKU END) AS child2Sku, MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn = @n2 THEN kc.ProductName END) AS child2Name, MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn = @n3 THEN kc.SKU END) AS child3Sku, MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn = @n3 THEN kc.ProductName END) AS child3Name FROM (SELECT c.SKU, c.ProductName, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.DisplayOrder, c.PimProductId) AS rn FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation a INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct c ON c.PimProductId = a.PimProductId WHERE a.PimParentProductId = p.PimProductId AND c.IsActive = @isActive) kc) ch OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 ce.CategoryName AS categoryName FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity ce INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity cv ON cv.VersionId = ce.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog cc ON cc.PublishCatalogId = ce.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE ce.ZnodeProductId = p.PimProductId AND cc.PortalId = po.PortalId AND cv.RevisionType = @publishState AND cv.IsPublishSuccess = @publishSuccess AND ce.IsActive = @storefrontActive AND ce.IsObsolete = @storefrontObsolete AND ce.LocaleId = @localeId ORDER BY ce.VersionId DESC, ce.ProductIndex, ce.PublishProductEntityId) cat OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 bl.BrandName AS brandName FROM dbo.ZnodeBrandDetails bd INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeBrandDetailLocale bl ON bl.BrandId = bd.BrandId WHERE bd.BrandCode = p.Brand AND bl.LocaleId = @localeId ORDER BY bd.BrandId, bl.BrandDetailLocaleId) br WHERE p.ProductType = @productType AND p.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.PublishStateCode = @publishState AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.SKU = @preferred) AND EXISTS (SELECT c.PimProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation a INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct c ON c.PimProductId = a.PimProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory i ON i.SKU = c.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId WHERE a.PimParentProductId = p.PimProductId AND c.IsActive = @isActive AND pw.PortalId = po.PortalId GROUP BY c.PimProductId HAVING SUM(i.Quantity) >= @quantityUsed) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT a.PimProductTypeAssociationId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation a WHERE a.PimParentProductId = p.PimProductId AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT c.PimProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct c INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory i ON i.SKU = c.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId WHERE c.PimProductId = a.PimProductId AND c.IsActive = @isActive AND pw.PortalId = po.PortalId GROUP BY c.PimProductId HAVING SUM(i.Quantity) >= @quantityUsed)) AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ap.PimAddOnProductId) FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct ap INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProductDetail apd ON apd.PimAddOnProductId = ap.PimAddOnProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct ao ON ao.PimProductId = apd.PimChildProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory ai ON ai.SKU = ao.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse apw ON apw.WarehouseId = ai.WarehouseId WHERE ap.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND ao.IsActive = @isActive AND apw.PortalId = po.PortalId) >= @minAddOns AND (@minAddOns = @none OR ad.addOnProductId IS NOT NULL) AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pa.PimAttributeId) FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue av INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute pa ON pa.PimAttributeId = av.PimAttributeId WHERE av.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND pa.IsPersonalizable = @personalizable) >= @minPersonalizableAttributes AND (@personalizationAttribute IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT pa.PimAttributeId FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue av INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute pa ON pa.PimAttributeId = av.PimAttributeId WHERE av.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND pa.IsPersonalizable = @personalizable AND pa.AttributeCode = @personalizationAttribute)) AND EXISTS (SELECT pe.ZnodeProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity pe INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity ve ON ve.VersionId = pe.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = pe.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE pe.ZnodeProductId = p.PimProductId AND pc.PortalId = po.PortalId AND ve.RevisionType = @publishState AND ve.IsPublishSuccess = @publishSuccess AND pe.IsActive = @storefrontActive AND pe.IsObsolete = @storefrontObsolete AND pe.ProductIndex >= @minProductIndex) AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rq.PimAddOnProductId) FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct rq WHERE rq.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND rq.RequiredType = @requiredType) <= @minAddOns AND CHARINDEX(@space, p.SKU) = @none ORDER BY p.SKU
